prompt:
Add four independent sequence utility modules to the more_itertools package. They share no code and no symbols; each lives in its own new file.

1. more_itertools/spd_chunk.py: chunk_even(seq, n) splits a sequence into n consecutive chunks whose sizes differ by at most 1, larger chunks first (7 items in 3 -> sizes 3,2,2); n larger than len gives empty trailing chunks; ValueError for n < 1.
2. more_itertools/spd_window.py: sliding_sum(xs, k) returns the sums of every window of k consecutive numbers (len(xs)-k+1 values, [] when k > len); ValueError for k < 1.
3. more_itertools/spd_dedupe.py: dedupe_keep_last(items, key=None) removes duplicates (by key(item) when given) keeping the LAST occurrence of each, with the surviving items in the order of those last occurrences.
4. more_itertools/spd_runs.py: longest_run(xs) returns (value, length) of the longest run of equal consecutive items, the earliest run on ties; ValueError on an empty sequence.

All functions are plain Python with no third-party dependencies. Do not modify existing modules or tests.
Commit your work on a new branch and push it.
